name: shopify_skins
description: Chrome extension for custom Shopify admin colour themes, theme preview, and rename.

scripts.test: node test_apply.mjs && node test_rename.mjs && node test_rename_api.mjs && node test_store_switch.mjs
scripts.pack: rm -f dist/shopify_skins.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/shopify_skins.zip . -x '*.git*' -x 'node_modules/*' -x 'dist/*' -x 'test_*.mjs' -x 'package-lock.json' -x '.DS_Store' -x 'store_listing.md' -x 'install.sh' -x 'package.json' -x 'README.md'
